save_sparse_csr: save a scipy sparse CSR matrix to disk using numpy savez format with optional metadata
load_sparse_csr: load a scipy sparse CSR matrix from a numpy savez file and return it with metadata
hash: compute an unsigned 32 bit murmurhash for a token string with configurable feature hash buckets
filter_ngram: decide whether to keep or discard an n-gram based on any, all, or ends filter mode
get_field: retrieve a nested subfield value from a dictionary using a list of field keys
